name: vitals_anomaly_check
description: Deterministic physiological safety envelope and IsolationForest anomaly test against astronaut baseline. Zero model arithmetic.

heart_rate.description: Heart rate in beats per minute (BPM), nominal range 50-95.

skin_temp.description: Skin temperature in degrees Celsius, nominal 35.5-37.5 C.

motion_g.description: Microgravity accelerometer magnitude in g, default 0.04.

name: trend_test
description: Deterministic Mann-Kendall non-parametric test and Theil-Sen slope estimator on a numeric series. The model must never compute this itself.

values.description: Sequential numerical measurements (e.g. daily heart rate, cytokine levels, or HRV).

dates.description: Optional ISO dates or day indices corresponding to the values.

name: osdr_search
description: Query NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) for spaceflight omics, immune, hematology, and analog studies (e.g. OSD-569, OSD-294, OSD-575).

query.description: Search keyword or biomarker name (e.g. 'cytokine', 'Inspiration4', 'Twin Study', 'cardiovascular').

limit.description: Maximum number of study accessions to return (default 5).

name: ntrs_search
description: Search NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS) and Human Research Program (HRP) evidence reports for flight medical countermeasures.

query.description: Medical risk or countermeasure topic (e.g. 'cardiovascular deconditioning', 'radiation limits', 'circadian lighting').

name: cite_check
description: Deterministic provenance gate. Return true only if every numeric claim in the payload maps to a verified dataset ID and an official source URL.
